name: auto-assign
description: Safety net that assigns any still-unowned backlog items to available agents. Primary dispatch happens at backlog grooming (issues are assigned at creation); this low-frequency routine only catches stragglers.

routines.title: Auto-assign unassigned issues
routines.description: Safety-net routine-run checklist: review still-unassigned todo issues plus active implementation/review capacity under company policy. If docs/lean-delivery.md exists, apply its WIP limits; otherwise no lean cap is implied. Assign only actionable work that fits owner and review capacity, keep later roadmap work inactive, record evidence and next actions on the routine issue, then exit.
